title: R3-SEC2: HLC LogEntry.hlc_timestamp loses logical+node_id
description: core/group_log/types.rs: LogEntry.hlc_timestamp is u64 (wall_ms only). verify.rs monotonicity check compares only wall_ms. Two entries at same ms with different logical counters: child fails check incorrectly. Need to store (wall_ms, logical) and compare as tuple.
